svg.title: W4A16 FP-INT GEMM two-path optimization for Vortex FPGA
svg.desc: Top path shows activation flowing through a fused element-wise + tile-layout kernel into a tile-major activation buffer. Bottom path shows weight tiled offline into int4 packed format. Both DRAM buffers feed the central W4A16 FP-INT GEMM core via DMA streams.
svg.text: unfused baseline: 1 extra DRAM write + read
Offline path: one-time at model load

g.text: fused kernel skips 1 DRAM write + 1 DRAM read of the full activation tensor every layer
